title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v77
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: Add a reproducible reporting pipeline for adaptive batching experiments and wire up representative workload runners and profiling baselines so results can be tracked in the benchmark lab dashboard. This PR introduces an adaptive batching workload runner, new profiling baseline manifests (cold-start + warm KV cache), a CI job to run nightly experiments, and a reporting pipeline that aggregates metrics and uploads consolidated reports to the internal warehouse. Changes: - New runner: benchmark-lab/runners/adaptive_batch_runner.py implements continuous batching policy hooks, tracepoints for latency/quantiles, and workload generators that mirror production prefix distributions. - Profiling baselines: benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/kv_cache_coldstart.yml and kv_cache_warm.yml capture baseline configs used by the profiler. - Reporting pipeline: benchmark-lab/reporting/pipeline/adaptive-batching-pipeline.yaml defines a Tekton pipeline that runs the workload, collects traces/pprof, and emits normalized CSV/JSON artifacts. - Docs: docs/benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching.md with runbook and interpretation guidance. - CI: ci/benchmarks.yml adds nightly job and test harness runner unit tests. Testing: Local unit tests added for runner behavior, end-to-end smoke runs validated on staging infra with small sample sizes. Bench results were run with the v77 matrix (2 models, 3 sequence lengths, 4 batching policies) to validate stability. Rollout plan: merge to main, staged nightly runs for 48 hours, and promote to full nightly cadence after signal validation. Checklist: [x] runner implemented [x] baselines added [x] pipeline defined [x] docs updated [x] unit + smoke tests added [x] CI green Notes: This PR intentionally keeps model variants and quantization profiles out of scope; follow-ups will add automatic model-matching rules to the pipeline.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add adaptive_batch_runner and unit tests (Aisha K.), 2) add profiling baselines and pipeline manifest (Aisha K.), 3) docs and CI job updates (Aisha K.)
review_comments: Initial review by Marco: requested clearer separation between workload generator and scheduler concerns and asked for extra metrics (p50/p95/p99 and batching utilization). Lei asked for an explicit timeout on pprof collection to avoid stuck jobs; author added a 30s collection timeout and documented it. Jordan requested CI coverage for the small-sample smoke run; added a lightweight smoke test to ci/benchmarks.yml. After addressing comments author responded with updated patches and ran the staging matrix; reviewers approved. Final approvals: Marco (approved), Lei (approved), Jordan (approved).
merge_outcome: merged via squash (squash and merge) into main on 2026-02-18
release_notes:
- Add adaptive batching workload runner and reporting pipeline (benchmark-lab)
- Add profiling baselines for KV cache cold-start and warm cache scenarios
- Nightly CI job to run bench lab experiments and push reports to warehouse
